audioNotice: Play a short audio ping when a new {brand.shortName} target notification arrives.
demoNotice: Reveals the theme's demo sections (Dashboard, Applications, Pages, UI Elements) in the sidebar. Off by default so the menu stays focused on {brand.shortName} Analytics.
mfaNotice: Every {brand.fullName} account must use a six-digit code from an authenticator app.
weeklyTargetsTip: Total {brand.shortName} targets generated during the selected trading week. When available, the comparison uses the prior 20 sessions.
